description: 대전광역시 서구_재난예경보시설현황 [disaster risk and hazard maps] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 대전광역시 서구. 더불어 구축연도, 모델명, 통신방식 등 장비 특성과 운영 환경을 나타내는 기술적 항목을 포함하고 있어, 재난 대응 체계 점검, 예경보 인프라의 적정성 평가, 지역별 위험도 분석, 시설. Coverage: 대전광역시 서구. The portal files it under the publisher 대전광역시 서구. Its tags are 재난방송, 마을회관, 경로당, 재난, 재난예경보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-20 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
